verdict.rationale: Multi-currency billing is a fair axis for a billing platform like Orb, but nothing in the evidence pack mentions local-currency invoicing, per-currency price points, or consolidating reports into a home currency. The revenue-reporting and export items (orb-docs-7, orb-docs-12, orb-docs-22) are adjacent features and say nothing about currency handling, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can bill customers in their local currency with per-currency price points and consolidated reporting in my home currency
